name: Creality Ender-3 V2 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; absolute positioning
M83 ; relative extrusion
M140 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single} ; start bed heating
M104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]} ; start nozzle heating
G28 ; home all axes
M190 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single} ; wait for bed temp
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]} ; wait for nozzle temp
G92 E0 ; reset extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000
G1 X0.1 Y20 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; move to prime line start
G1 X0.1 Y200.0 Z0.3 F1500.0 E15 ; prime line 1
G1 X0.4 Y200.0 Z0.3 F5000.0
G1 X0.4 Y20 Z0.3 F1500.0 E30 ; prime line 2
G92 E0
G1 Z2.0 F3000
machine_end_gcode:
G91 ; relative positioning
G1 E-2 F2700 ; retract
G1 E-2 Z0.2 F2400 ; retract and raise Z
G1 X5 Y5 F3000 ; wipe
G1 Z10 ; raise Z
G90 ; absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y220 ; present print
M106 S0 ; fan off
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M84 X Y E ; disable motors
